text: AKTOR Group's shares trade on the Athens Stock Exchange: a July 2026 capital increase was completed and the new shares were admitted to trading on the Athens Exchange.
short: AKTOR Group shares trade on the Athens Exchange.

source.name: newmoney.gr: Aktor: Στο 33,41% το ποσοστό της Winex μετά την ΑΜΚ
